title.zh: KelpDAO sues LayerZero and CEO over $292M rsETH bridge exploit - CoinDesk
title.en: KelpDAO sues LayerZero and CEO over $292M rsETH bridge exploit - CoinDesk

current_state.zh: KelpDAO母公司Evercrest Technologies对LayerZero Labs及其CEO的诉讼仍在进行，LayerZero否认指控；约145亿美元资产已宣布从LayerZero迁移至Chainlink CCIP，案件正检验跨链安全责任划分。
current_state.en: Evercrest Technologies, KelpDAO's parent, is suing LayerZero Labs and its CEO, with LayerZero denying the claims; roughly $14.5B in assets have announced migrations from LayerZero to Chainlink CCIP, and the case is testing cross-chain security responsibility.

updates.title_zh: Nearly $15B is moving off LayerZero, now a $292M lawsuit puts its security model on trial
updates.title_en: Nearly $15B is moving off LayerZero, now a $292M lawsuit puts its security model on trial
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道披露：原告为KelpDAO母公司Evercrest Technologies，在加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省起诉LayerZero Labs及CEO Bryan Pellegrino，指控过失、虚假陈述和诽谤，并称攻击后Kelp用户已提取超6.5亿美元；约145亿美元资产宣布从LayerZero迁移至Chainlink CCIP；LayerZero CEO称诉讼无依据。
updates.what_changed_en: New coverage discloses that plaintiff is Evercrest Technologies, KelpDAO's parent, suing LayerZero Labs and CEO Bryan Pellegrino in British Columbia on claims of negligence, misrepresentation and defamation; Kelp users have withdrawn over $650M since the attack; roughly $14.5B in assets have announced migrations from LayerZero to Chainlink CCIP; and LayerZero's CEO called the suit meritless.

updates.current_state_en: Evercrest Technologies, KelpDAO's parent, is suing LayerZero Labs and its CEO, with LayerZero denying the claims; roughly $14.5B in assets have announced migrations from LayerZero to Chainlink CCIP, and the case is testing cross-chain security responsibility.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: KelpDAO parent Evercrest Technologies sued LayerZero Labs and CEO Bryan Pellegrino in British Columbia over April's $292M rsETH exploit, alleging negligence, misrepresentation, and defamation, as roughly $14.5B in assets have announced migrations from LayerZero to Chainlink CCIP.
updates.detailed_summary_en: KelpDAO parent Evercrest Technologies sued LayerZero Labs and CEO Bryan Pellegrino in British Columbia over April's $292M rsETH exploit, alleging negligence, misrepresentation, and defamation, as roughly $14.5B in assets have announced migrations from LayerZero to Chainlink CCIP.
